notes.key_messages:  Candidates should read the whole task carefully before starting to write their answers.  Candidates are advised to highlight or underline key words in questions and sub-tasks.  Candidates should ensure that they respond in the same time frame as used in the question.
notes.general_comments: The full ability range was represented. The gradient of difficulty in the questions allowed the majority of candidates to show what they knew and could do. In each question, there are key words which inform the candidates of what is required. Candidates must be aware of these, otherwise they risk producing work which may be linguistically accurate but which is in some measure irrelevant. It is particularly important that candidates are aware of the full range of interrogative adverbs, e.g. Combien ? which can be used in a number of ways and does not only refer to the cost of things.
